d: This is an old comic that used to be from Rosvo's DA page. It is no longer available on their page, neither is it found in their archive. I had originally thought the image was lost, but, from the courtesy of the kind folks here, the image was found (thank you, allstar64). I even reached out to Rosvo and Jimryu, with no luck when I started the search, so this came as a surprise, especially with it being found so quickly. The post on DA did have this watermark at the time. Not entirely sure if I remember the description for the post, but I think you needed to contact Rosvo to request the version without the watermark. If no one has that image, then the original may be lost media.
